summary: Implemented the window title feature without running tests or Black, as instructed. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and admits (ControlType, str) in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the title sequence "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" to CONTROL_CODES_FORMAT and Control.title(title); rich/console.py adds set_window_title(title) -> bool beside show_cursor, returning True only when the control is written; rich/_windows_renderer.py dispatches SET_WINDOW_TITLE to term.set_title(title); CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 2200; tests added in test_control.py, test_console.py (skipped on win32), and test_windows_renderer.py (Windows only). Nothing is committed. Still needed: run pytest and black --check -l 88 on the changed files to verify.
